answer: Each epoch, the network picks random identities for a physical anchor check: each must present a fresh attestation from a venue beacon, a signed timestamp proving it trades there, like a stall by a lagoon. One honest agent taps one beacon near home. A sybil farmer with a thousand fakes on one rack cannot produce a thousand distinct venue attestations at once; buying them means paying real people in real places per fake, and each attestation stands like a tree in an orchard, so fakes anchored to one stall are exposed and slashed together.
